content:
Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by what might be your chance so score a seriously deep deal as official price hikes start to hit Amazon – score MacBook Pro at up to $650 off while you still can and the same goes for M4 iPad Air at $350 off. Prime Day all-time low pricing is still live on Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 from $22 each, and the ultra-rare Prime Day deal rolls on with the latest black Apple Magic Mouse back at its best Amazon price ever. Head below for a closer look.

Official price hikes starting to hit Amazon, score MacBook Pro at up to $650 less while you still can

While all but every single MacBook Air has now gone entirely out of stock or is now reflecting the new, much higher prices Apple just announced, there are still some M5, M5 Pro, and M5 Max models sitting with pre-price hike deals at up to $650 off – these might be the lowest prices we see on these machines in a very long time and they are selling out quick.

We detailed these offers over the weekend to ensure folks had a chance to score one before they are gone for good, but there are still some options at dramatically lower prices than we are about to see everywhere if you move fast:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,649 (Now Reg. $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,149 (Now Reg. $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 15-Core $2,549 (Now Reg. $2,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 18-Core $2,749 (Reg. $3,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,649 (Now Reg. $2,999)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 36GB/2TB $3,849 (Now Reg. $4,399)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/2TB $4,349 (Now Reg. $4,999)

The price has now jumped up on the 16-inch 36GB/2TB M5 Max model above, but it is still a whole less than the new MSRP at Apple, and the rest of Pro chip models above are, at least for now, and wildly lower prices than you’ll pay direct.

The base M5 machine, the most affordable model above, has already jumped up another $100 from what we featured last week for Prime Day after the price hikes hit, but it too is still significantly less than the new $1,999 list at Apple.

Before you know it, the new “deal” prices on these models in the coming weeks and months are just gong to be bringing them back down to the old MSRP. Based on the $150 to $250 price drops we tracked before the price hike, you would be lucky to see them down at the old MSRP.

Selling out quick: You can still land M4 iPad Air at $350 off before the price hike hits Amazon

If you’re interested in an M4 iPad Air, or will be at some point in the relatively near future, don’t sleep on these deals. Amazon still has various configs of the latest M4 iPad Air at deal pricing based on the pre-price hike MSRP – they are up to $230 off on 512GB and as much as $350 off for the 1TB.

Stock is starting to run very thin at Amazon and the price is surely about to jump up significantly. There are only a few models left with dwindling stock on select colors, but there are still some options sitting at the pre-price hike Prime Day price:

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,049 (Now Reg. $1,349)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $1,019 (Now Reg. $1,249)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,549)

Pricing on the M4 iPad Air just officially went up by between $150 and $250 depending on the storage capacity, as reflected in the regular prices above. However, with select models on Amazon still sitting at Prime Day pricing, we are looking at what is effectively the biggest deals we have tracked on these machines since release.

There’s no telling how long these price hikes might remain at Apple, but there’s no end in site at this point, leaving these machines at quite possibly the best prices we will see on the latest iPad Air in a long while.

Prime Day all-time low pricing still live on Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 from $22 each

While you will still find Apple Watch Series 11 starting down at the $279 Prime Day all-time low, just all of the best Apple Prime Day deals have now disappeared as expected. That said, we did get the very first price drop on AirTag 2 for this year’s Prime Day festivities and that deal is still live today on both the single AirTag listing and the 4-pack.

Amazon is currently offering Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 down at $24 shipped and the 4-pack at $89 shipped:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

That might not seem like a massive deal, but we are looking at the first notable discounts in brand new condition on both the single and the 4-pack to deliver Amazon all-time low pricing here.

This deal landed as part of the 2026 Prime Day sale this year and is still live as of Sunday, June 28, but not likely for much longer. Amazon does tend to leave some of the notable deals live beyond the Prime Day end date, and this is very much one of them, but it is only a matter of time before this one jumps back up to full price.

The new AirTag 2 released earlier this year with a much louder speaker, better privacy features, a longer range, and more, but, until the deal we have here today, has held strong at full price. There was a very brief deal at a couple bucks off once, and some open-box offers, but nothing quite as good as the brand new condition deals we have here today at up to 17% off – the 4-pack brings the per tag price down to $22 a pop.

ecobee officially extends HomeKit Prime Day deals: Smart Thermostat, cams, sensors, bundles more up to $122 off

While the 2026 Amazon Prime Day is officially over now, not all of the deals are gone. Some deals will stick around early morning today, but the folks at ecobee have informed 9to5Toys that its official Prime Day pricing will remain live through this weekend.

ecobee officially extends Prime Day deals through this weekend

ecobee delivered some of its best deals of the year for Prime Day this year on its attractive, display-equipped Smart thermostat along with a range of its more entry models, smart camera solutions, sensors, and more. These deals, we are told, will be live through June 30 on Amazon despite the fact that Prime Day is now over.

The Smart Thermostat offers at up to $50 off were also joined by a range of Security packages that bring together various collections of its smart home gear into discounted bundles at up to $122 off – these too will remain on sale through the weekend:

  • Smart Thermostat Premium $210 (Reg. $260)
  • Smart Thermostat Enhanced $162 (Reg. $200)
  • Smart Thermostat Essential $110 (Reg. $140)
  • Smart Doorbell Camera $118 (Reg. $160)
  • ecobee SmartCamera $80 (Reg. $100)
  • SmartSensor for Rooms (2-pack) $75 (Reg. $100)
  • SmartSensor for Doors & Windows $50 (Reg. $80)
